name: AIsa Dev
description: Technical documentation for AIsa, the unified resource and transaction network for AI agents: models, APIs, real-time data, Agent Skills, authenticated actions, discovery, and usage-based access.

options.title: Run this in your agent
options.description: Copy one block into your agent and run this endpoint — OAuth, no key to paste

options.title: Add AIsa MCP to Cursor
options.description: Every AIsa API as MCP tools behind one endpoint: mcp.aisa.one/mcp

markdown.instructions:
- Documentation and API environment: dev. Use a dev API key.
- API base: https://dev-api.aisa.one/apis/v1. Follow each operation’s servers.
- Immutable Runtime OpenAPI: https://dev-api.aisa.one/public/api-contract/releases/fd2c6eb804451f0b5b43394920277e31eb733e884c1f2662befd87f715137024/contracts/openapi.json
